rubrics.justification: Describes a generally good expanded blastocyst consistent with the reported 3AA, but repeatedly notes uncertainty about ICM/TE visibility and adds subjective features like irregular blastocoel/granularity that are not clearly established from the image.
Strong integration of age, ovarian reserve, prior IVF outcomes, ectopic history, endometrial thickness, smoking, BMI, diagnosis, and semen parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately tempered by recurrent failures despite good age/embryo quality; minor looseness from giving slightly varying implantation ranges and some speculative comments.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: SET at age 31 with a good blastocyst, lifestyle optimization, luteal support review, early ectopic surveillance, and uterine cavity evaluation after repeated failures. Minor deviations include discussing ERA/PGT-A somewhat speculatively.

Provides clear next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, smoking/alcohol cessation, prenatal vitamins, progesterone/luteal review, serial beta-hCG and early ultrasound, and cavity/chronic endometritis workup if failure recurs.
